description_en: Creates a meal application in Alibaba Business Travel, typically used to synchronize meal application data
description_zh: 通过调用本接口实现在阿里商旅中新增用餐申请单数据，通常用于用餐申请单数据的同步
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen meal-apply-add --third-part-apply-id 1234 --meal-cause '测试' --status 0 --apply-user user_id=userId1 --itinerary-list '[{"end_date":"2025-02-05_00:00:00","cities":[{}],"thirdpart_itinerary_id":"2134","start_date":"2025-02-05_00:00:00"}]' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MealApplyAdd

parameters.help_en:
The third-party application ID.
Enter a unique identifier. It is displayed in the application forms, orders, and bills in Alibaba Business Travel
parameters.help_zh:
三方申请单Id
建议录入唯一标识，会在阿里商旅的申请单、订单、账单中展示
parameters.name: third_part_apply_id

fields.help_en:
The employee ID.

Enter the business travel employee "user_id"
fields.help_zh:
员工Id

需录入商旅员工“user_id”
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en:
The city code.
Only cities in the Chinese mainland are supported (Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China) are not supported).
For city codes, refer to Domestic City Six-Letter Code Data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
fields.help_zh:
城市编码
仅支持中国大陆城市（中国港澳台均不支持）。
城市code参照国内城市六字码数据 (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
fields.name: city_code

fields.help_en:
The end time. The value must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss string format.

Time zone: China
fields.help_zh:
结束时间（时间参数填写必须为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 字符串格式）

时区：中国
fields.name: end_date

fields.help_en:
The start time. The value must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss string format.

Time zone: China
fields.help_zh:
开始时间（时间参数填写必须为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 字符串格式）

时区：中国
fields.name: start_date

fields.help_en:
The third-party itinerary ID.

Enter a unique identifier. It is displayed in the application forms, orders, and bills in Alibaba Business Travel
fields.help_zh:
第三方行程Id

建议录入唯一标识，会在阿里商旅的申请单、订单、账单中展示
fields.name: thirdpart_itinerary_id

parameters.help_en:
The meal amount limit.
Currency: CNY. Unit: cents
parameters.help_zh:
用餐额度
货币：人民币，单位：分
parameters.name: meal_amount

parameters.help_en: The internal business travel invoice header ID. Specify either this parameter or the third-party invoice header ID
parameters.help_zh: 商旅内部发票抬头Id，和第三方发票抬头Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: invoice_id

parameters.help_en: The third-party invoice header ID. Specify either this parameter or the business travel invoice header ID
parameters.help_zh: 三方发票抬头Id，和商旅发票抬头Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: third_part_invoice_id

parameters.help_en: The internal business travel cost center ID associated with the application. Specify either this parameter or the third-party cost center ID
parameters.help_zh: 申请单关联的商旅内部成本中心Id，和第三方成本中心Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: cost_center_id

parameters.help_en: The third-party cost center ID associated with the application. Specify either this parameter or the business travel cost center ID
parameters.help_zh: 申请单关联的三方成本中心Id，和商旅成本中心Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: third_part_cost_center_id

parameters.help_en: The extended information. Pass supplementary descriptions in this field. The content is displayed in bills. This is typically used for enterprise travel statistics and reconciliation
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息。

可将补充描述传入此字段，账单中将会体现对应内容。一般可以用于企业差旅统计和对账，
parameters.name: extend_field

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
